key.name: items
key.description: Built-in and custom item identifiers shown in the panel.

key.name: replace-quick-settings
key.summary: Replace the built-in Quick Settings button
key.description: Hide GNOME's built-in Quick Settings indicator.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Panel section where custom buttons are placed.

key.name: hidden-original-items
key.summary: Hidden entries in the original Quick Settings menu
key.description: Independent of which separate top-bar buttons are enabled.

key.name: hidden-original-icons
key.summary: Hidden icons in the original system indicator
key.description: Hide original status icons without hiding the menu or separate buttons. Privacy indicators are preserved.

key.name: manage-panel-layout
key.description: Retained for upgrade compatibility. It no longer enables global panel ordering.

key.name: manage-global-panel-layout
key.description: Opt in to observing and moving third-party panel items. Disabled by default for stability.

key.name: panel-layout
key.description: Ordered status-area roles for the left, center and right sections. Empty uses the native layout with custom buttons immediately before original Quick Settings.

key.name: panel-items
key.description: Runtime-generated inventory for the layout preferences. This is not a user setting.

key.name: custom-panel-spacing
key.description: Override horizontal button padding, extra icon margins and grouped indicator gaps. Disable to restore the current theme.

key.name: panel-button-padding
key.summary: Horizontal panel button padding per side

key.name: system-tiles
key.summary: Enabled large system tiles in display order
key.description: Each enabled tile replaces its compact counterpart inside the original menu. Disabling it restores the compact control.

key.name: system-tile-labels
key.summary: Custom labels for large system tiles

key.name: compact-system-tiles
key.description: Show square action icons with hover labels instead of full-size labeled tiles. Accessible names and menu actions are preserved.

key.name: compact-battery-percentage
key.summary: Show live percentage below the compact battery icon

key.name: hidden-system-controls
key.summary: Hidden compact controls in the system header
key.description: Controls with a large tile enabled are shown as tiles; otherwise these compact icons are hidden.

key.name: panel-item-aliases
key.description: Maps transient runtime roles to stable application/object-path identities for restart-safe positions.
